summary: Render the Ghost Ship map at its native 1672x941 pixel rectangle with no Foundry scene padding and an explicit identity background transform so authored wall/light coordinates share the same origin as the artwork.

operations.after:
background: {
      src: MAP_PATH,
      scaleX: 1,
      scaleY: 1,
      offsetX: 0,
      offsetY: 0,
      rotation: 0
    },

checks.name: Background identity transform present
checks.run: grep -q 'scaleX: 1' scripts/orphaned-sun-scenes.mjs && grep -q 'scaleY: 1' scripts/orphaned-sun-scenes.mjs && grep -q 'offsetX: 0' scripts/orphaned-sun-scenes.mjs && grep -q 'offsetY: 0' scripts/orphaned-sun-scenes.mjs
